description.zh: 截图、标注、贴图、长截图、识别文字、录屏和演示白板
description.en: Screenshots, annotations, pins, long screenshots, text recognition, screen recording and a presentation whiteboard

notes.zh: “复制为表格”认得合并单元格：粘进 Excel、WPS 表格或 Word，合并的单元格照样合并，一格里几行字的还在一格，表格上面的标题和下面的备注各占一行，前面带 0 的编号、很长的数字不变样；有框线的表格按画出来的线分格，没有框线的用随插件自带的表格模型（PaddleOCR 的 SLANet_plus，7 MB，在本机算）。选着标注工具时，在空白处双击同样完成截图，右键、中键、侧键设的动作也照常执行。复制整屏截图时少占内存，图里的字只读一遍（#467）。权限不变。
notes.en: Copy as a table knows merged cells: pasted into Excel, WPS or Word, merged cells arrive merged, a cell of several lines stays one cell, a title above and a note below get rows of their own, and codes with a leading zero or long numbers stay as they are; a ruled table is read from its drawn lines, one without by the table model that now comes with the plugin (PaddleOCR's SLANet_plus, 7 MB, on this PC). With an annotation tool on, a double click on the bare picture finishes the capture and the actions set for the right, middle and side buttons run. Copying a full-screen capture takes less memory and its words are read once (#467). Permissions unchanged.
